mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id as accountId, symbol, side, quantity, price, status, created_on as createdOn, idempotencyKey, fill_price as fillPrice FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId}
SELECT id, account_id as accountId, symbol, side, quantity, price, status, created_on as createdOn, idempotencyKey, fill_price as fillPrice FROM orders WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (id, account_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, status, idempotencyKey, created_on, fill_price) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdOn}, #{fillPrice}) ON CONFLICT (idempotencyKey) DO UPDATE SET status = #{status}, fill_price = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fill_price, orders.fill_price)
mapper.select: SELECT id as orderId, account_id as accountId, symbol, side, quantity, price, created_on as createdOn FROM orders WHERE status = 'NEW' AND created_on < (NOW() - (#{seconds}::int || ' seconds')::INTERVAL) LIMIT #{limit}
